mbpp_instruct.note: tokens_to_close is the count of generated tokens up to and including the closing ``` fence. Decoding was greedy (do_sample=false, seed=42), so the first N tokens of a 2048-token completion are the same tokens a max_gen_toks=N run would have produced; thresholding tokens_to_close at 256 therefore replays the 256-token run rather than modelling it.

gpqa_diamond_cot_zeroshot.note: strict-match uses regex '(?<=The answer is )(.*)' but the task's own doc_to_text asks for the answer inside \boxed{}. The two are inconsistent, so strict-match scores 0 for any model that follows the prompt. flexible-extract uses the boxed_choice filter and is the configured result_key.
